_note: RESCUE PROBE R2 (plan OT-9H): a use in orbit, then a ride with its own person. Her words are Jessica's; the real one is MB104a once this plays.

Reading it: fly to the container and use it. The box shows, she is aboard, the objective is the city. Walk back: a greeting and three questions, none required. Land at Akila City: she gets off, it completes and pays.
Also try: land without ever talking to her (it should still complete). Any fault at the start is the new city aliases on the orbit quest: the object and orbit play on MB104a.

prose.name: Recovery: Rescue Probe over <Planet>
prose.briefing: Test mission. A cargo container is drifting over <Planet>. Open it and fly whoever is inside to <SecondPlace>.
prose.card: Test contract. Container lost over <Planet>, four days adrift. Find it and bring it in.

message.title: Lost Cargo Container
message.text: The lock is on the outside. You open it, and she climbs straight across into your airlock.

beats.journal: The container over <Planet> wasn't machine parts. A woman had spent four days in it. I took her aboard and flew her to <SecondPlace>.
greeting: I've never been so glad to see the inside of someone else's ship. I'll stay out of your way. Where do you want me?

exchanges.prompt: Sit anywhere. I'll get you to a city.
How did you end up in a cargo box?
reply: I needed a way off that rock, and the box was going. It seemed like a good idea for about an hour.
Hungry. Stiff. Very tired of the dark. Nothing a city won't fix.

broadcast: Is that a ship? Please be a ship. I've been in this box four days and the air scrubber's started making a noise I don't like, so if you're here for the container, I'm in it.
